senses.gloss: c. (v. גָּרַע II) globule, esp. the stone or kernel of a stone fruit, nut &c.—Pl. גַּרְעִינִין, גַּלְעִינִין, גַּרְאִי׳.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:4">Sabb. VII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 76b">76ᵇ</cite>) <he>גרעינין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גַּרְעִינֵיהֶן</he>); Y. ed. <he>גַּלְעִינֵיהֶן</he>. Bab. ib. 77ᵇ top, question as to spelling with <cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite> or <cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite> (decided by ref. to <he>ונגרע</he> <cite ref="Leviticus 27:18">Lev. XXVII, 18</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 11:5">Ter. XI, 5</cite> <he>גַּרְעִינֵי תרומה</he> (Ms. M. <he>גל׳</he>) stones of fruits which are the priest’s share.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 10:1">Tosef. ib. X, 1</cite>; a. fr. V. <cite ref="C01386"><he>גַּרְעִינָה</he></cite>.
